answer: In a market for translating a fable about umber cliffs and a zephyr, pay for verified text segments, not registered accounts. Fix one reward per segment, record commitments before revealing work, and have independent reviewers test quality. A completed segment is marked paid across all identities. A Sybil farm must produce additional acceptable translations and bear their computation and review costs; copying its own output earns nothing extra. This assumes honest reviewers and reliable duplicate detection.
